params.name: Top bar button
params.tooltip:
How the Industry Flows button in the top-left bar looks.
Text: the word "Flows" without a frame. Icon: a factory icon
on a dark tile, like the game's data layers button.

params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Industry Flows writes how
long its panel took to read the map, render and redraw the
arrows to the game's log file (stdout.txt, lines starting
with [SQPERF]). Only for tracking down slowdowns; leave it
Off otherwise. Slow calls are always logged briefly,
whatever this setting.
